title: Retry After Decline
description: FR-1004's payment retry flow needs to work with the same form the customer already has open — no page reload, no re-entering the whole invoice from scratch, just a second card number.
successCondition: On the same open invoice, paying first with 4000000000000002 (declined) and then, without navigating away, submitting the same Pay form again with a well-formed non-special card number: the second attempt succeeds, the Badge updates to "paid", the payment form disappears, and the attempt list shows exactly two lines — "Attempt 1: declined (...)" followed by "Attempt 2: succeeded" — in that order.
hints: The card number field is cleared after each submit (setCardNumber('')), so type a fresh number for the second attempt rather than assuming it persists.
Attempt numbers are assigned server-side and are per-invoice, not global — don't hardcode an expectation from a different invoice's history.
